text: BMW built this car to go racing. The rules changed before the first one was done. They needed 400 road cars to qualify, so they hired Lamborghini. Then Lamborghini ran out of cash, seven prototypes in. So every car crossed the Alps: Italian body, Italian frame, finished in Stuttgart. It still made 277 horsepower and 160 miles an hour. They built 453, then made a series where it could only race itself. The car wasn't the failure. The plan was.
